tabs.tab_title: What do we need to get started?
tabs.tab_content: A product owner, access to a representative dataset and one engineer. We run the first workshop inside your workspace, so nothing leaves your environment.
Aurora is model-agnostic. Route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral and your own fine-tunes per step, and switch providers without touching application code.

tabs.tab_title: How do you handle data privacy?
tabs.tab_content: Data can stay in the EU or the US, is encrypted in transit and at rest, and PII is redacted before it reaches a model. We are SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR ready.

Growth includes a guided 30-day onboarding. Enterprise engagements include a named success manager and a quarterly review of your agent portfolio.
Monthly plans are month-to-month. Annual agreements include a discount and a commercial SLA with committed uptime and response times.
